segments.text: Lesson 35
segments.translation: 第35课

segments.text: Justice was done
segments.translation: 伸张正义

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: The word 'justice' is given two different meanings in the text.
segments.translation: “正义”一词在课文中给出了两种不同的含义。

segments.text: What is the distinction between them?
segments.translation: 它们之间的区别是什么？

segments.text: The word justice is usually associated with courts of law.
segments.translation: 正义这个词通常是与法院联系在一起的。

segments.text: We might say that justice has been done when a man's innocence or guilt has been proved beyond doubt.
segments.translation: 当一个人的清白或罪行被证明属实、毫无疑问时，我们可能会说，正义得到了伸张。

segments.text: Justice is part of the complex machinery of the law.
segments.translation: 正义是复杂的法律机器的一部分。

segments.text: Those who seek it, undertake an arduous journey and can never be sure that they will find it.
segments.translation: 寻觅正义的人，要经历一段艰难的历程，且永远不能肯定他们是否能找到它。

segments.text: Judges, however wise or eminent, are human and can make mistakes.
segments.translation: 法官们不论多么聪明、多么杰出，都是人，也会犯错误。

segments.text: There are rare instances when justice almost ceases to be an abstract concept.
segments.translation: 在极少数情况下，正义几乎不再是一个抽象的概念。

segments.text: Reward or punishment are meted out quite independent of human interference.
segments.translation: 奖赏或惩罚是在完全不受到人为干扰的情况下被执行的。

segments.text: At such times, justice acts like a living force.
segments.translation: 在这些时刻，正义就像是一种活生生的力量。

segments.text: When we use a phrase like 'it serves him right', we are, in part, admitting that a certain set of circumstances has enabled justice to act of its own accord.
segments.translation: 当我们使用“他罪有应得”这样的话语时，我们在某种程度上承认，是一组特定的环境使正义得以自发地起作用。

segments.text: When a thief was caught on the premises of a large jewellery store one morning, the shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right'.
segments.translation: 一天早晨，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店的范围内被抓住时，店里的营业员们一定觉得无法忍不住说出那句“他罪有应得”。

segments.text: The shop was an old converted house with many large, disused fireplaces and tall, narrow chimneys.
segments.translation: 这家商店是一座由旧房子改建而成的，里面有许多巨大的、废弃不用的壁炉和高大狭窄的烟囱。

segments.text: Towards midday, a girl heard a muffled cry coming from behind one of the walls.
segments.translation: 接近中午时，一位姑娘听见从一堵墙的后面传出闷声闷气的叫声。

segments.text: As the cry was repeated several times, she ran to tell the manager who promptly rang up the fire brigade.
segments.translation: 由于叫声重复了好几次，她跑去告诉了经理，经理随即给消防队打了电话。

segments.text: The cry had certainly come from one of the chimneys, but as there were so many of them, the firemen could not be certain which one it was.
segments.translation: 叫声确实是从其中一个烟囱里传出的，但由于烟囱太多，消防队员无法确定是哪一个。

segments.text: They located the right chimney by tapping at the walls and listening for the man's cries.
segments.translation: 他们通过敲击墙壁听那人的叫声，从而确定了位置。

segments.text: After chipping through a wall which was eighteen inches thick, they found that a man had been trapped in the chimney.
segments.translation: 在凿开一堵18英寸厚的墙后，他们发现一个人被困在烟囱里了。

segments.text: As it was extremely narrow, the man was unable to move, but the fire fighters were eventually able to free him by cutting a huge hole in the wall.
segments.translation: 由于烟囱极其狭窄，那人无法动弹，但消防员们最终在墙上挖了一个大洞而救出了他。

segments.text: The sorry-looking, blackened figure that emerged, admitted at once that he had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.
segments.translation: 那个露出来的浑身漆黑、面容可怜的人随即承认，他曾试图在夜里闯进这家商店计，但卡在了烟囱里。

segments.text: He had been there for nearly ten hours.
segments.translation: 他在那里已经被困了将近10个小时。

segments.text: Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
segments.translation: 甚至在这人被交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。
